title: pvStreamTracerWithCustomSource
body:
## pvStreamTracerWithCustomSource

Integrates steady streamlines like pvStreamTracer, but every point of a second input (SeedSource) that lies inside the dataset starts a streamline, so any node's points can seed it: a probe line, a slice, an inlet patch or points read from a file. The vector field must be point-centred with 3 components. The output is polydata polylines carrying the input point arrays interpolated along each line, IntegrationTime, and cell arrays SeedIds and ReasonForTermination (1 left the domain, 4 maximum length, 5 maximum steps, 6 below terminal speed); with ComputeVorticity on (ParaView default) Vorticity, Rotation, AngularVelocity and Normals are added. With direction BOTH, N seeds give up to 2N lines.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Step lengths default to Cell Length units (fractions of a cell), not dataset lengths; set IntegrationStepUnit to Length before giving steps in metres.
- MaximumStreamlineLength has a static default of 1.0 that ParaView may replace with the input size; set it explicitly, or long streamlines can be cut short in large domains.
- A seed source with thousands of points produces thousands of lines; use a coarser seed node.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `StreamTracerWithCustomSource`. Identity: `filters/ArbitrarySourceStreamTracer`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Stream Tracer filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). The input needs at least one point-centred array with 3 components. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `SeedSource` | Required data input for the native SeedSource port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":[],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ComputeVorticity` | Specify whether to compute vorticity. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `InitialStepLength` | This property specifies the initial integration step size. For non-adaptive integrators (Runge-Kutta 2 and Runge-Kutta 4), it is fixed (always equal to this initial value) throughout the integration. For an adaptive integrator (Runge-Kutta 4-5), the actual step size varies such that the numerical error is less than a specified threshold. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `IntegrationDirection` | This property determines in which direction(s) a streamline is generated. | `{"type":"enum","values":["FORWARD","BACKWARD","BOTH"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"FORWARD"` |
| `IntegrationStepUnit` | This property specifies the unit for Minimum/Initial/Maximum integration step size. The Length unit refers to the arc length that a particle travels/advects within a single step. The Cell Length unit represents the step size as a number of cells. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Length","Cell Length"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Length"` |
| `IntegratorType` | This property determines which integrator (with increasing accuracy) to use for creating streamlines. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Runge-Kutta 2","Runge-Kutta 4","Runge-Kutta 4-5"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Runge-Kutta 2"` |
| `InterpolatorType` | This property determines which interpolator to use for evaluating the velocity vector field. The first is faster though the second is more robust in locating cells during streamline integration. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Interpolator with Point Locator","Interpolator with Cell Locator"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Interpolator with Point Locator"` |
| `MaximumError` | This property specifies the maximum error (for Runge-Kutta 4-5) tolerated throughout streamline integration. The Runge-Kutta 4-5 integrator tries to adjust the step size such that the estimated error is less than this threshold. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MaximumStepLength` | When using the Runge-Kutta 4-5 integrator, this property specifies the maximum integration step size. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MaximumSteps` | This property specifies the maximum number of steps, beyond which streamline integration is terminated. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MaximumStreamlineLength` | This property specifies the maximum streamline length (i.e., physical arc length), beyond which line integration is terminated. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MinimumStepLength` | When using the Runge-Kutta 4-5 integrator, this property specifies the minimum integration step size. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SurfaceStreamlines` | Specify whether to compute surface streamlines. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `TerminalSpeed` | This property specifies the terminal speed, below which particle advection/integration is terminated. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `UseLocalSeedSource` | If true the filter considers that the whole seed source is available on all ranks. Else the filter will aggregate all seed sources from all ranks and merge their points. WARNING: do not set this value to true unless you know what you're doing. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Vectors` | This property contains the name of the vector array from which to generate streamlines. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"maxItems":2,"minItems":2,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvStreamTracerWithCustomSource",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input",
    "SeedSource": "UPSTREAM_SeedSource"
  }
}
```
